reports.title: David Mitchener: Prevention of future deaths report

concerns.quote: Vitamin supplements can have potentially very serious risks and side effects when taken in excess
Current food labelling requirements do not require these risks and side effects to be written on the packaging
concerns.hazard: inadequate labeling of vitamin D supplements

concerns.quote: Absence of appropriate warnings and guidance about dosage

reports.title: Christopher Brazil: Prevention of Future Deaths Report
categories: Alcohol, drug and medication related deaths
Wales prevention of future deaths reports (2019 onwards)

concerns.quote: There are unregulated and unlawful websites offering prescription only medicines and controlled drugs, which look legitimate and are found easily from simple online searches; and these sites give rise to the following points (2) to (6)
concerns.hazard: unregulated and unlawful online pharmaceutical providers

concerns.quote: Vulnerable and susceptible people are exposed to counterfeit or unsafe medications
concerns.hazard: exposure to counterfeit or unsafe medications

concerns.quote: There are insufficient or no measures to verify patient medical history before selling the medication and drugs
concerns.hazard: insufficient or no measures to verify patient medical history before selling medication and drugs

concerns.quote: There is a lack of guidance regarding dosage
There are a lack of safeguards to prevent incorrect self-diagnoses or misuse by consumers
concerns.hazard: lack of safeguards to prevent incorrect self-diagnoses or misuse by consumers

concerns.quote: There is inadequate age and identity verification, potentially allowing minors to access restricted medicines and drugs

links.explanation: Both reports highlight a lack of guidance about appropriate dosage for medications. The earlier case concerns vitamin supplement labelling, while the later case concerns unregulated online pharmacies.
